**Symbol:** `GenUUID` — `internal/util/util.go:40`

**Approx fan-in:** ~28 call sites across the repo (via `util.GenUUID()`), the most of any symbol I found declared under `internal/`. Of those, roughly 7 are non-test production callers (`server/auth/token.go:194`; `server/router/api/v1/auth_service_session.go:26,135`; `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service_storage.go:209`; `server/router/api/v1/user_service_access_tokens.go:84`; `server/router/api/v1/shortcut_service.go:154`; `server/router/api/v1/sso_username.go:15`), and the remaining ~21 are test call sites (mostly `server/router/api/v1/test/auth_test.go`, plus `server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go` and `server/router/api/v1/test/authz_test.go`).

I compared this against the other widely-used `internal/` symbols I could find (`filter.DefaultEngine`/`AppendConditions` ~6–7, `scheduler.New` ~12, `webhook.ValidateURL`/`ValidateSigningSecret` ~6, `s3.NewClient` ~5, `version.GetCurrentVersion` ~5), and none approached `GenUUID`'s fan-in. This is a repo-wide grep-based count rather than a full call-graph analysis, so I can't guarantee absolute precision, but the margin over the next-highest candidates makes `GenUUID` the clear leader.
